# Bangladesh Study Abroad & China University Cost Benchmark Dataset (2027)

Open CC BY 4.0 higher-education benchmark published by **EduExpress International** (https://eduexpressint.com/press, Dhanmondi, Dhaka, Bangladesh).

## Highlights
- **159 verified active universities** (150 in China across 61 cities, 9 in Malaysia; 100% mapped to official institutional domains)
- **898 structured programs** with degree level, medium of instruction, duration, intakes, explicit tuition, and official source URLs
- **888 itemized non-tuition fee rows** (dormitory, medical insurance, residence permit, EMGS Student Pass, application fees) kept strictly separate from tuition
- **276 scholarship tracks** (CSC, Provincial/City Government, University Merit, Belt & Road, CLEC)
- **12-destination Bangladesh outbound matrix** comparing indicative tuition, monthly living costs, and Bangladesh Bank AD Student File remittance requirements

## Live Reports & APIs
- Press Room & Media Briefs: https://eduexpressint.com/press
- China Study Cost Report: https://eduexpressint.com/china-study-report-bangladesh (Live JSON: https://eduexpressint.com/china-study-report.json)
- Bangladesh Market Benchmark 2027: https://eduexpressint.com/bangladesh-study-abroad-market (Live JSON: https://eduexpressint.com/bangladesh-study-abroad-market.json)
- Verification Standard: https://eduexpressint.com/how-we-verify-universities
